Jarir National Day Offers: Huge Discounts on High-Performance Gaming Consoles
Jarir Bookstore has implemented a 26% discount on the MSI Vector gaming laptop, designating the price reduction as part of the celebrations for the 95th Saudi National Day.
The promotion is available to consumers through the company’s network of physical branches across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as well as via its official electronic store. According to the retailer, the discounted price is applied directly to the hardware, eliminating the need for promotional coupons to access the offer.
Technical Specifications
The MSI Vector featured in the promotion is equipped with a 13th Generation Intel Core i9 processor. For graphical rendering and visual performance, the laptop utilizes an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 graphics card. The system is supported by 32 GB of random access memory (RAM) and a solid-state drive (SSD) providing up to 1 terabyte of storage.
The hardware includes a 16-inch QHD display capable of a 240 Hz refresh rate. Thermal management is handled by the Cooler Boost 5 professional cooling system, designed to maintain performance during high-intensity operations. The device also features a customizable RGB backlit keyboard.
The company has specified that this offer is available for a limited time, with the promotional window scheduled to close on October 2, 2025.
